items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Mental (Head).

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Inward: uses the mind to build a pleasant inner structure and protect itself from the outer world.

items.label: Central issue
items.value: Anxiety and insecurity tied to a felt lack of inner guidance and support.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoid suffering (physical and moral), limitations, and boredom at all costs.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Gluttony: an insatiable desire for experiences/pleasures to fill an inner void.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Planning: filling the mind with exciting future projects so as not to feel the discomfort of the present.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Rationalization: positive justifications of the negative in order to avoid pain.

items.label: Egotic pride
items.value: I am optimistic, I am happy.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being deprived of everything or trapped in pain.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Being satisfied, fulfilled, and happy.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Family / Clan (Defender): security through networks of alliances and protection to ensure comfort.

children.label: Social
children.value: Sacrifice (countertype): sacrifices personal gluttony in service of a collective ideal in order to feel good.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Suggestibility / fascination: rose-tinted glasses, idealization of reality.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Assertive (aggressive): approaches people to get what it needs for its happiness.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Positive Outlook: reframes positively in order to avoid discomfort.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 6 (more anxious and loyal) and wing 8 (more direct, powerful, grounded).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 5: deeper, focused, quiet, assimilates experiences at depth.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 1: rigidity, criticism, impatience, demands, and perfectionism.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Wisdom, Holy Work, Holy Plan: reality unfolds harmoniously without the ego's intervention.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Sobriety (temperance): staying with a single experience at a time without seeking distraction.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Vehicle of pleasure (Markabah): the multidimensional richness of Being.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Disorientation / the feeling of being lost.

children.label: Specific reaction
children.value: Planning: creating a false sense of direction.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Separate unfolding: believing it must direct its own fulfillment.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner little 5: felt empty/deprived, escaped through imagination.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Stories (sagas, anecdotes, jokes) and planning.

items.label: Communication misunderstanding
items.value: Lightness-Superficiality: joy can be perceived as a lack of seriousness or commitment.

sections.title: Evolution and relationships
sections.desc: Warning signs, growth practices, confusions, interactions.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: A racing mind, a frantic multiplication of activities, avoidance of any serious/painful topic.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Silence, presence with pain without fleeing, realizing that happiness comes from within.

items.label: Common confusions
items.value: 3 (energy), 2 (charm), 9 (optimism).

children.label: Overview
children.value: Stimulating and funny, but can exhaust those around it through the flow of activities and difficulty committing.

children.label: In love
children.value: Adventurous, fears being smothered and any final commitment that would limit its options.

children.label: At work
children.value: Visionary, strong at brainstorming, but follow-through can be weak after the initial excitement.

levels.text: Accomplished generalist: links experiences, practical wisdom.
Experienced sophisticate: the pursuit of experiences, refinement.
Impulsive escapist: panicked avoidance, erratic decisions.
Compulsive maniac: extreme agitation, unable to stop.

items.label: Consciousness
items.value: Moving from the trance of distraction to self-remembering in the present moment.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: ORANGE (success/opportunism/progress) and sometimes RED (impulsiveness/force).

items.label: Analogy
items.value: Monkey mind: leaping from branch to branch, forgetting it is already at the top of the tree of its own Essence.
